qa_pairs.question: Which plug connections are covered under section 61 13?
qa_pairs.answer: Door plug connection to body, fuse box screws for safety fuse, and ground or positive connections

qa_pairs.question: Are all the torque specifications in the plug connections table the same?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all plug connections have the same torque specification of 5 Nm
